inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if primary evidence cannot establish material AI-enabled insurance-workflow differentiation or durable risk-adjusted economics, or if the consumer-insurance focus, catastrophe and reserve volatility, reinsurance and capital costs, regulation, continuing losses, or lack of SMB system-of-record exposure dominate the proposed transmission.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Lemonade's AI-enabled underwriting, policy servicing, claims, fraud, compliance, and customer-service workflows may provide a regulated-insurance operating-system adjacency, but the transmission must be material to shareholder value and distinct from the idea's core SMB accounting, payroll, tax, banking, commerce, and payments system-of-record mechanism.

objective: Review whether Lemonade has a material positive relationship to the AI-native SMB financial operating-systems idea through regulated insurance operations.
